page.overview:
What is Hamath?

Hamath was a Corondorian city on the border of the Plains of Urlan and the northermost city on the Tenamis River. Reigned by the Guides of Hamath from the Ziggurat of Hamath and the seeress Kadesha. After the fall of Arathoxia, Hamath had difficulty with trade. Strong did she stand against the growing shadow – and warily she guarded the House Kadesha, the throne of Pearl Magic.

Jared Carthalion destroyed Rifa's Inn in a brawl with some locals (Daro, Cor, Gensai and others).
